sections.text: We are pleased to report that recycled plastic resin costs have decreased 15% this quarter, improving our margins. We use recycled polyethylene terephthalate to produce our eco-friendly construction panels. Our long-term supply agreement with EcoPlast Recycling ensures stable access to this key input.
